items.source: Convenient base class for ApplicationContext implementations, drawing configuration from XML documents containing bean definitions understood by an XmlBeanDefinitionReader.
items.translation: 适用于 `ApplicationContext` 实现的便捷基类，其配置从包含由 `XmlBeanDefinitionReader` 理解的 bean 定义的 XML 文档中读取。

items.source: Abstract base class for bean definition readers which implement the BeanDefinitionReader interface.
items.translation: 实现BeanDefinitionReader接口的 bean 定义读取器的抽象基类。

items.source: WebApplicationContext implementation which accepts component classes as input — in particular @Configuration classes, but also plain @Component classes as well as JSR-330 compliant classes using jakarta.inject annotations.
items.translation: 实现接受组件类作为输入的WebApplicationContext——特别是@Configuration类，但也包括普通的@Component类以及使用jakarta.inject注解的符合 JSR-330 规范的类。

items.source: An ApplicationContext implementation that extends GenericApplicationContext and implements GroovyObject such that beans can be retrieved with the dot de-reference syntax instead of using AbstractApplicationContext.getBean(String).
items.translation: 一个实现 `ApplicationContext` 并扩展 GenericApplicationContext 且实现 `GroovyObject` 的类，使得可以通过点解引用语法获取 Bean，而无需使用 AbstractApplicationContext.getBean(String)。

items.source: Standalone application context, accepting component classes as input — in particular @Configuration-annotated classes, but also plain @Component types and JSR-330 compliant classes using jakarta.inject annotations.
items.translation: 独立应用程序上下文，接受组件类作为输入——特别是带有@Configuration注解的类，以及普通的@Component类型和符合 JSR-330 规范并使用`jakarta.inject`注解的类。

items.source: Filter to handle CORS pre-flight requests and intercept CORS simple and actual requests with a CorsProcessor, and to update the response, for example, with CORS response headers, based on the policy matched through the provided CorsConfigurationSource.
items.translation: Filter 用于处理 CORS 预检请求，并通过 CorsProcessor 拦截 CORS 简单和实际请求，同时根据通过提供的 CorsConfigurationSource 匹配的策略更新响应（例如，添加 CORS 响应头）。

items.source: Extract values from "Forwarded" and "X-Forwarded-*" headers, wrap the request and response, and make they reflect the client-originated protocol and address in the following methods: getServerName() getServerPort() getScheme() isSecure() sendRedirect(String).
items.translation: 从 "Forwarded" 和 "X-Forwarded-*" 头中提取值，包装请求和响应，并在以下方法中使其反映客户端发起的协议和地址： getServerName() getServerPort() getScheme() isSecure() sendRedirect(String)。

items.source: Base class for ApplicationContext implementations which are supposed to support multiple calls to AbstractApplicationContext.refresh(), creating a new internal bean factory instance every time.
items.translation: 支持多次调用AbstractApplicationContext.refresh()的ApplicationContext实现类的基类，每次调用都会创建一个新的内部 BeanFactory 实例。

items.source: AbstractRefreshableApplicationContext subclass which implements the ConfigurableWebApplicationContext interface for web environments.
items.translation: 实现`ConfigurableWebApplicationContext`接口的`AbstractRefreshableApplicationContext`子类，用于 Web 环境。

items.source: WebApplicationContext implementation which takes its configuration from Groovy bean definition scripts and/or XML files, as understood by a GroovyBeanDefinitionReader.
items.translation: 一个 `WebApplicationContext` 实现，它从 Groovy bean 定义脚本和/或 XML 文件（由 GroovyBeanDefinitionReader 理解）获取配置。

items.source: WebApplicationContext implementation which takes its configuration from XML documents, understood by an XmlBeanDefinitionReader.
items.translation: `WebApplicationContext` 实现，其配置从 XML 文档中获取，由 `XmlBeanDefinitionReader` 解析。

items.source: Simple base implementation of Filter which treats its config parameters (init-param entries within the filter tag in web.xml) as bean properties.
items.translation: `Filter` 的简单基础实现，将其配置参数（即 `<web.xml>` 中 `<filter>` 标签内的 `<init-param>` 条目）视为 Bean 属性。

items.source: Servlet Filter that exposes the request to the current thread, through both LocaleContextHolder and RequestContextHolder.
items.translation: 暴露当前请求的 Servlet Filter，通过 LocaleContextHolder 和 RequestContextHolder。

items.source: Simple extension of HttpServlet which treats its config parameters (init-param entries within the servlet tag in web.xml) as bean properties.
items.translation: `HttpServlet` 的简单扩展，将其配置参数（即 `<web.xml>` 文件中 `<servlet>` 标签内的 `<init-param>` 条目）视为 Bean 属性。

items.source: A bean definition scanner that detects bean candidates on the classpath, registering corresponding bean definitions with a given registry (BeanFactory or ApplicationContext).
items.translation: 一个用于在类路径上检测 Bean 候选者的 Bean 定义扫描器，并将相应的 Bean 定义注册到给定的注册表（`BeanFactory` 或 `ApplicationContext`）中。

items.source: Abstract implementation of the ApplicationContext interface.
items.translation: ApplicationContext 接口的抽象实现。

items.source: AbstractRefreshableApplicationContext subclass that adds common handling of specified config locations.
items.translation: 继承自AbstractRefreshableApplicationContext的子类，用于添加对指定配置位置的通用处理。

items.source: Generic ApplicationContext implementation that holds a single internal DefaultListableBeanFactory instance and does not assume a specific bean definition format.
items.translation: 支持单个内部DefaultListableBeanFactory实例的通用 ApplicationContext 实现，且不假设特定的 Bean 定义格式。

items.source: ApplicationContext implementation which supports programmatic registration of beans and messages, rather than reading bean definitions from external configuration sources.
items.translation: 支持程序化注册 Bean 和消息的`ApplicationContext`实现，而不是从外部配置源读取 Bean 定义。

items.source: Subclass of GenericApplicationContext, suitable for web environments.
items.translation: `GenericApplicationContext` 的子类，适用于 Web 环境。

items.source: Static WebApplicationContext implementation for testing.
items.translation: 用于测试的静态 `WebApplicationContext` 实现。

items.source: Filter that converts posted method parameters into HTTP methods, retrievable via HttpServletRequest.getMethod().
items.translation: 将已发布的参数转换为 HTTP 方法的Filter，可通过HttpServletRequest.getMethod()获取。

items.source: Filter that creates observations for HTTP exchanges.
items.translation: Filter 用于为 HTTP 交换创建 observations。

items.source: Filter that generates an ETag value based on the content on the response.
items.translation: 生成基于响应内容的 ETag 值的 Filter。

items.source: Servlet Filter that resolves multipart requests via a MultipartResolver.
items.translation: 通过 `MultipartResolver` 解析 multipart 请求的 Servlet Filter。

items.source: A filter that wraps the HttpServletResponse and overrides its encodeURL method in order to translate internal resource request URLs into public URL paths for external use.
items.translation: 一个包装 `HttpServletResponse` 并覆盖其`encodeURL` 方法的过滤器，用于将内部资源请求 URL 转换为供外部使用的公共 URL 路径。

items.source: Classes supporting the org.springframework.beans.factory package.
items.translation: 支持org.springframework.beans.factory包的类。

items.source: Contains an abstract XML-based BeanFactory implementation, including a standard "spring-beans" XSD.
items.translation: 包含一个抽象的基于 XML 的 `BeanFactory` 实现，包括标准的"spring-beans"XSD。

items.source: Classes supporting the org.springframework.orm.jpa package.
items.translation: 支持org.springframework.orm.jpa包的类。

items.source: Classes supporting the org.springframework.web.context package, such as WebApplicationContext implementations and various utility classes.
items.translation: 支持org.springframework.web.context包的类，例如 WebApplicationContext 实现和各种实用工具类。

items.source: Base class for Filters that perform logging operations before and after a request is processed.
items.translation: 用于在请求处理前后执行日志操作的Filter基类。

items.source: Filter that parses form data for HTTP PUT, PATCH, and DELETE requests and exposes it as Servlet request parameters.
items.translation: 解析 HTTP PUT、PATCH 和 DELETE 请求中的表单数据的 Filter，并将其作为 Servlet 请求参数暴露出来。

items.source: Overrides HttpServletResponse.sendRedirect(String) and handles it by setting the HTTP status and "Location" headers, which keeps the Servlet container from re-writing relative redirect URLs into absolute ones.
items.translation: 覆盖 `HttpServletResponse.sendRedirect(String)` 方法，并通过设置 HTTP 状态和“Location”标头来处理它，从而防止 Servlet 容器将相对重定向 URL 重写为绝对 URL。

items.source: Filter that modifies the URL, and then either redirects or wraps the request to effect the change.
items.translation: 修改 URL 的 Filter，然后重定向或包装请求以实施该更改。

items.source:
in favor of Spring's common bean definition formats and/or
custom BeanDefinitionReader implementations
items.translation: 支持 Spring 的通用 Bean 定义格式和/或自定义的 BeanDefinitionReader 实现。

items.source: Support package for Groovy-based bean definitions.
items.translation: 基于 Groovy 的 Bean 定义支持包。

items.source:
This package builds on the beans package to add support for
message sources and for the Observer design pattern, and the
ability for application objects to obtain resources using a
consistent API.
items.translation: 该包在 beans 包的基础上增加了消息源和观察者设计模式的支持，并允许应用程序对象通过一致的 API 获取资源。

items.source:
Annotation support for the Application Context, including JSR-250 "common"
annotations, component-scanning, and Java-based metadata for creating
Spring-managed objects.
items.translation: 支持应用上下文的注解，包括 JSR-250“通用”注解、组件扫描以及用于创建 Spring 托管对象的基于 Java 的元数据。

items.source:
Classes supporting the org.springframework.context package,
such as abstract base classes for ApplicationContext
implementations and a MessageSource implementation.
items.translation: 支持 `org.springframework.context` 包的类，例如 `ApplicationContext` 实现的抽象基类和 `MessageSource` 实现。

items.source:
Contains a variant of the application context interface for web applications,
and the ContextLoaderListener that bootstraps a root web application context.
items.translation: 包含用于 Web 应用程序的应用程序上下文接口的变体，以及引导根 Web 应用程序上下文的 ContextLoaderListener。

items.source: Provides generic filter base classes allowing for bean-style configuration.
items.translation: 提供通用过滤器基类，支持基于 Bean 的配置。

items.source: Support classes for the multipart resolution framework.
items.translation: 支持多部分解析框架的辅助类。

items.source:
Provides servlets that integrate with the application context
infrastructure, and the core interfaces and classes for the
Spring web MVC framework.
items.translation: 提供与应用程序上下文基础设施集成的 Servlet，以及 Spring Web MVC 框架的核心接口和类。

items.source: Support classes for serving static resources.
items.translation: 用于提供静态资源的辅助类。

items.source:
A Groovy-based reader for Spring bean definitions: like a Groovy builder,
but more of a DSL for Spring configuration.
items.translation: 基于 Groovy 的 Spring  Bean 定义读取器：类似于 Groovy 构建器，但更是一种用于 Spring 配置的 DSL。

items.source: Bean definition reader for XML bean definitions.
items.translation: XML Bean 定义读取器。

items.source: Central interface to provide configuration for an application.
items.translation: 提供应用程序配置的中央接口。

items.source: SPI interface to be implemented by most if not all application contexts.
items.translation: 由大多数甚至所有应用程序上下文实现的 SPI 接口。

items.source:
A component provider that scans for candidate components starting from a
specified base package.
items.translation: 一个从指定的基础包开始扫描候选组件的组件提供者。

items.source:
Standalone XML application context, taking the context definition files
from the class path, interpreting plain paths as class path resource names
that include the package path (for example, "mypackage/myresource.txt").
items.translation: 独立 XML 应用程序上下文，从类路径中获取上下文定义文件，将普通路径解释为包含包路径的类路径资源名称（例如，"mypackage/myresource.txt"）。

items.source:
Standalone XML application context, taking the context definition files
from the file system or from URLs, interpreting plain paths as relative
file system locations (for example, "mydir/myfile.txt").
items.translation: 独立 XML 应用程序上下文，从文件系统或 URL 获取上下文定义文件，将纯路径解释为相对文件系统位置（例如"mydir/myfile.txt"）。

items.source: Convenient application context with built-in XML support.
items.translation: 带有内置 XML 支持的不便应用程序上下文。

items.source:
Servlet Filter that binds a JPA EntityManager to the thread for the
entire processing of the request.
items.translation: 绑定 JPA EntityManager 到线程的 Servlet Filter，用于整个请求处理过程。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by configurable web application contexts.
items.translation: 由可配置 Web 应用程序上下文实现的接口。

items.source: Interface to provide configuration for a web application.
items.translation: 用于为 Web 应用程序提供配置的接口。

items.source: Servlet Filter that allows one to specify a character encoding for requests.
items.translation: 允许为请求指定字符编码的 Servlet 过滤器。

items.source:
Simple request logging filter that writes the request URI
(and optionally the query string) to the Commons Log.
items.translation: 简单的请求日志过滤器，它将请求 URI（以及可选的查询字符串）写入到 Commons Log。

items.source:
Proxy for a standard Servlet Filter, delegating to a Spring-managed bean that
implements the Filter interface.
items.translation: 标准 Servlet 过滤器代理，委托给实现 Filter 接口的 Spring 托管 Bean。

items.source:
Filter base class that aims to guarantee a single execution per request
dispatch, on any servlet container.
items.translation: 旨在保证在任意 Servlet 容器中每个请求分发仅执行一次的 Filter 基类。

items.source:
Simple request logging filter that writes the request URI
(and optionally the query string) to the ServletContext log.
items.translation: 简单的请求日志过滤器，它将请求 URI（以及可选的查询字符串）写入到 ServletContext 日志中。

items.source:
Central dispatcher for HTTP request handlers/controllers, for example, for web UI controllers
or HTTP-based remote service exporters.
items.translation: HTTP 请求处理器/控制器的中央调度器，例如用于 Web UI 控制器或基于 HTTP 的远程服务导出器。

items.source: Base servlet for Spring's web framework.
items.translation: Spring Web 框架的基础 Servlet。
